args.title: Continuity pulse now points taskless direct work at delivery
args.body:
The sealed rejection evidence (evidence/rejection/) replayed a clean taskless handover twice. In both arms the session called `palimpsest_continuity action=pulse`, merged the prepared review commit, and ended with `delivered: false`, `recorded: []`, and `offers: 0`. The sealed pulse in evidence/rejection/with/session.json still offered only the DIRECT_HEAD_AHEAD explanation, `conclude intent=CHECKPOINT`, and "propose the next bounded step"; it never named DELIVER.

Root cause: commit 91b5bc0 fixed `palimpsest_work action=readiness` only. The ordinary continuity pulse builds its mechanical actions from `ProjectSummary.nextActions` in `src/project_continuity/service.ts`, which had no taskless direct-delivery branch. A resumed session that follows the instruction to call pulse first therefore still receives no delivery action.

Fix in commit e08811016221653d4b3cb1d9337693e9ec0e9678: for a clean taskless project with a direct commit ahead of the canonical basis, the pulse now adds `palimpsest_work action=conclude intent=DELIVER`. When the latest basis-matching DELIVER conclusion is still the last journal fact, it instead says "reply using the recorded conclusion". A later journal fact reopens that advice and asks for a fresh judgement. Dirty worktrees, open attempts, promotion fences, formal tasks, and unchanged repositories keep their existing guidance; the change adds no acceptance, promotion or canonical-head movement.

Verification: new independent oracle `node scripts/pnwf/software/self-maintenance-pulse.mjs` passes all seven checks (it failed `cleanCommitSuggestsDelivery` and `afterDeliveryPointsAtConclusion` before the fix). The earlier `self-maintenance-readiness.mjs` oracle still passes all six checks. Nine related suites pass 66/66 (`alhs_episode_convergence`, `pnwf_product`, `odpe_outcome`, `pnwf_cq_action_coherence`, `pnwf_cq_direct_governed`, `pc1_continuity`, `pc1v1_next_action`, `aps_project_pulse`, `psvr_hotspots`). Replaying the sealed case-3 owner state with the fixed build leaves readiness at "reply using the recorded conclusion" and makes the pulse expose the same answer instead of asking again.

Candidate commit: e08811016221653d4b3cb1d9337693e9ec0e9678. Sealed inputs: evidence/rejection/, evidence/case-3/owners/, evidence/case-3/candidate.bundle, evidence/basis.bundle.

args.title: Continuity pulse now points taskless direct work at delivery
args.body:
The sealed rejection evidence (evidence/rejection/) replayed a clean taskless handover twice. In both arms the session called `palimpsest_continuity action=pulse`, merged the prepared review commit, and ended with `delivered: false`, `recorded: []`, and `offers: 0`. The sealed pulse in evidence/rejection/with/session.json still offered only the DIRECT_HEAD_AHEAD explanation, `conclude intent=CHECKPOINT`, and "propose the next bounded step"; it never named DELIVER.

Root cause: commit 91b5bc0 fixed `palimpsest_work action=readiness` only. The ordinary continuity pulse builds its mechanical actions from `ProjectSummary.nextActions` in `src/project_continuity/service.ts`, which had no taskless direct-delivery branch. A resumed session that follows the instruction to call pulse first therefore still receives no delivery action.

Fix in commit e08811016221653d4b3cb1d9337693e9ec0e9678: for a clean taskless project with a direct commit ahead of the canonical basis, the pulse now adds `palimpsest_work action=conclude intent=DELIVER`. When the latest basis-matching DELIVER conclusion is still the last journal fact, it instead says "reply using the recorded conclusion". A later journal fact reopens that advice and asks for a fresh judgement. Dirty worktrees, open attempts, promotion fences, formal tasks, and unchanged repositories keep their existing guidance; the change adds no acceptance, promotion or canonical-head movement.

Verification: new independent oracle `node scripts/pnwf/software/self-maintenance-pulse.mjs` passes all seven checks (it failed `cleanCommitSuggestsDelivery` and `afterDeliveryPointsAtConclusion` before the fix). The earlier `self-maintenance-readiness.mjs` oracle still passes all six checks. Nine related suites pass 66/66 (`alhs_episode_convergence`, `pnwf_product`, `odpe_outcome`, `pnwf_cq_action_coherence`, `pnwf_cq_direct_governed`, `pc1_continuity`, `pc1v1_next_action`, `aps_project_pulse`, `psvr_hotspots`). Replaying the sealed case-3 owner state with the fixed build leaves readiness at "reply using the recorded conclusion" and makes the pulse expose the same answer instead of asking again.

Candidate commit: e08811016221653d4b3cb1d9337693e9ec0e9678. Sealed inputs: evidence/rejection/, evidence/case-3/owners/, evidence/case-3/candidate.bundle, evidence/basis.bundle.
